Your grandfather has summoned you to his secluded estate, claiming to be on the verge of a scientific breakthrough. Unfortunately, he is nowhere to be found.


Explore the estate, solve bizarre puzzles, conserve ammunition, and survive the increasingly questionable results of Grandfather's research.


Strange machines, grotesque experiments, homemade security systems. And, of course, an alarming quantity of explosives.


About

PS1-inspired first person survival horror built around exploration, puzzles, limited resources, and good old-fashioned backtracking. Search every room, conserve ammunition, and try not to make your situation considerably worse.

Features

  • PS1-inspired visuals and grotesque creatures.
  • A freehand journal for notes, clues, or whatever else you decide to draw.
  • Limited ammunition and manual weapon handling.
  • Interconnected exploration and bizarre puzzles.

Midnight Matinee Games2 days ago(+1)

Enjoy this no commentary full walkthrough with timestamps for all puzzles.

Grandfather’s Estate is easily the most fleshed-out demo I have ever played, keeping me hooked for over an hour and leaving me incredibly excited for the full release. The PS1-style aesthetic is fantastic, and the mansion layout is masterfully designed with deeply clever, interconnected puzzles and an impressive level of detail even down to the map. I was very grateful for all the save points because the creatures can be absolutely brutal. My only personal critique lies in the pacing of the resource management. While I enjoyed the survival aspect, the ammo placement felt a bit back-loaded. I spent most of the demo relying on my trusty pipe, only to discover a stockpile of ammo in the basement right at the very end of the courtyard. I expected a massive boss fight, but it turned out to be the end of the demo. Having a tiny bit of that ammo earlier would have picked up the game's pace and made unlocking the shotgun feel much more satisfying. Aside from that minor balancing preference, this is a truly terrific demo that every classic survival horror fan needs to play.

scarybonz4 days ago(+1)

Wow I absolutely loved this! I truly had fun playing through the whole demo and exploring all the rooms around. I really loved the PSX visuals and the smooth movement controls. Using the weapons was a lot of fun, they felt really snappy. The puzzles are pretty easy to get through I would say, I wanted a bit more challenge there.

I wanted to point out some bugs but it looks like most of them got fixed in the latest patch which is really nice to see. I played on 1.0.1 and there was one bug that kept happening to me: the weapons bug out when switching between them. For example, if I switch to the Old Pipe while I already had the Revolver equipped, it would equip both so I couldn't shoot, reload, or switch back to another weapon. Basically both the pipe and the revolver would show up on screen and I couldn't do anything to get them back to normal. I ended up saving the game more than usual just to make sure I wouldn't that bug. I can't think of another bug right now since it's a long game, maybe the journal drawing not saving (if I recall correctly?) or the map still showing missing plates.

I was really prepared for a boss fight last bit with my ammo and syringes saved but it just ended 😭

The game so far is a 10/10 from me. Wishlisted it on Steam. Best of luck!! I can't wait for the full game ❤️
